map.抑菌率和对数减少值有什么不同？: How Do the Bacterial Reduction Rate and the Log Reduction Differ?
map.抑菌率是活菌减少的百分数，直观；对数减少值(log reduction)表示数量: The reduction rate is the percentage drop in viable bacteria, which is intuitive; the log reduction expresses the drop in orders of magnitude and is more sensitive for highly antibacterial samples. Evaluating both gives a more complete picture.
